This E log book also reflects my patient-centred online learning portfolio and your valuable comments on comment box is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EName:- Kattekola Sathwik\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERoll No :- 75\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECase Report \u003C\/b\u003E:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E60\/F farmer came with complaints of\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETingling sensation of both lower limbs since 3 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ecomplaints of bilateral knee pain since 5 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EComplaints of burning micturition since 3 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Epatient was apparently asymptomatic 10 years ago then\u0026nbsp; she developed tingling sensations,numbness and burning sensations of both lower limbs since 10 years(slrt-negative)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EComplaints of bilateral knee pains since 5 years which is insidious in onset gradually progressive , crepitus present no morning stiffness, tenderness,swelling\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eaggravating with prolonged standing and on activity and relieving on rest and generalised body pains\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EComplaints of burning micturition since 3 years which is not associated with fever with chills,frequency,urgency,hesitancy,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Epoor stream of urine,dribbling of urine\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E(Aggravates after eating non veg)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o trauma\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o polyuria,polydypsia,polyphagia\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o chest pain,sob,palpitations\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo c\/o fever,pain abdomen,vomiting,loose stools,cough,cold\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPast History\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o renal calculi 7 years ago\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o ?cerebral malaria 10 years ago\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/c\/o DM since 20 years(on medication of tab.metformin 500mg po\/bd)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Not a k\/c\/o Tb,epilepsy,bronchial asthma,cva,cad,HTN\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPersonal History\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe takes mixed diet\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Esleep normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Estools\u0026nbsp;
